lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-intensity circular pixel clusters in approximately 11-12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; columns typically contain 4-5 blobs between the dorsal ridge and the pectoral fin level.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light grey/white) intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most dorsal ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and a deep shadow on the inferior edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible area of the first dorsal fin contains a cluster of approximately 10-14 discrete high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, primarily concentrated on the anterior half of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing (posterior) edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits a ragged and irregular margin, contrasting with the smooth leading edge, indicating potential tissue loss or historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the ventral-lateral region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin base.
